name: Preparing Magikal Ink

VINIT.justification: the pre-material state before ink is drawn from the source

TANCH.justification: the physical boundary that contains the ink and prevents dispersion

AFWD.justification: the act of extracting ink from the source toward the writing surface

AREV.justification: the descent of ink back into the vessel, reversing the flow

CLINK.justification: the joining of strokes to form a complete sigil, chaining forward and reverse actions

IMSCRIB.justification: the sigil that knows itself as both symbol and substance

FSPLIT.justification: the ink splits into two paths: one for inscription, one for invocation

FFUSE.justification: the two ink streams recombine into a single flow after completing their purpose

EVALT.justification: the ink successfully inscribes a working sigil

EVALF.justification: the ink fails to hold its charge and becomes inert

ENGAGR.chosen_element: ink is both glowing and dry
ENGAGR.justification: a paradice where the sigil is simultaneously active and inert, held in balance

IFIX.justification: a permanent mark that cannot be undone, fixed in stone

phase_3.void_description: the ink sac is empty, no ink drawn
phase_3.true_description: the sigil is inscribed and glows with power
phase_3.both_description: the sigil is both glowing and dry, a stable paradox

steps.domain_action: begin with the void, the state before ink is drawn
seal the ink sac to contain the magikal essence
draw ink from the source toward the writing surface
retract ink that does not adhere, returning it to the vessel
connect the drawn ink to form a continuous sigil
the sigil recognizes itself as both ink and symbol
the ink divides into two streams—one for inscription, one for invocation
the inscriptive stream successfully forms the sigil
the invocative stream fails to ignite
the ink is both glowing and dry, a stable paradice
the two ink streams recombine into a single flow
the sigil is engraved into stone, a permanent record

phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — the ink is conserved through the cycle
